principle: An ecology is a finite, fully declared object. Every phase claim names the axes it varies and freezes every other axis. Axes are chosen so that at least one parent theorem already proves a tractability/learnability flip along the axis (P9B ledger); Track B adds the morphology-class and resource-frontier reading on top, it does not re-prove the flips.
tuple: E = (D_tau, O, A, F, V, p, b, H, Delta)   (V1 symbols)

data_volume.parent_flip: computational-statistical tradeoff (Shalev-Shwartz-Shamir-Tromer 2012; Decatur-Goldreich-Ron 1999): more samples can buy less compute; which learner is efficient changes with sample count
data_volume.predicted_lever: favors M4/M5 as volume rises (parametric fit / memorization amortize), M2/M3 when tiny

noise.parent_flip: SQ noise tolerance (Kearns 1998): SQ-learnable classes tolerate classification noise; exact-counterexample learners (M1/M2) do not by default
noise.predicted_lever: noise penalizes exact-verification morphologies unless V supplies noise-robust checks

smoothness.parent_flip: universal approximation is resource-blind (P9A); depth-separation lower bounds (Telgarsky 2016) charge non-smooth targets
smoothness.predicted_lever: smooth targets favor M4; discrete/combinatorial favor M1/M2

compositionality.parent_flip: library learning amortization (HST-T05 macro threshold; DreamCoder/Stitch ablations, P5 ledger)
compositionality.predicted_lever: deep compositional + reuse favors M2 library forms

algorithmic_structure.parent_flip: parity is not SQ/gradient-learnable but is exactly searchable (Kearns 1998; Shalev-Shwartz et al. 2017; Abbe et al. 2021); automata are passively hard but query-learnable (Gold 1978 / Pitt-Warmuth 1993 vs Angluin 1987)
algorithmic_structure.predicted_lever: PARITY_LIKE is a frozen kill-axis for M4 under scalar_loss

exactness.parent_flip: none needed: exact contracts change V's cost function directly
exactness.predicted_lever: EXACT_REQUIRED penalizes M4 unless paired with a verifier (M6)

partial_observability.parent_flip: HST-T03 representation insufficiency; POMDP belief-state parents
partial_observability.predicted_lever: stochastic partial observability favors M3 (belief = trace distribution)

drift.parent_flip: stability-plasticity (Grossberg; EWC, P4 ledger); tracking regret parents (HSG)
drift.predicted_lever: frequent shift charges rev; local-update morphologies (M1/M5) revise cheaper than dense M4

revision_frequency.parent_flip: HST-T06 dependency-cone locality: revocation cost is local iff dependency semantics are complete
revision_frequency.predicted_lever: frequent revocation favors provenance-carrying M1/M2/M5 over M4 (no cone)

reuse_horizon.parent_flip: HST-T05 macro amortization: H_eff * dC_use > C_build + C_maint + C_rev
reuse_horizon.predicted_lever: long reuse amortizes expensive-to-build forms (M4 training, M2 libraries)

verification_strength.parent_flip: Angluin 1987 L*: DFA learning polynomial with membership+equivalence queries; Gold 1978 / Pitt-Warmuth 1993 / Kearns-Valiant 1994: intractable passively. Same target class, opposite tractability, axis = verification contract.
verification_strength.predicted_lever: the single most important axis for M0/M1/M2 acquisition (D2)

interaction_cost.parent_flip: value of information / Blackwell with probe cost (HST-T08)
interaction_cost.predicted_lever: priced queries shift M2 (query-hungry) toward M3/M4 (sample-hungry)

feedback_type.parent_flip: differentiable vs PAC vs SQ (Abbe et al. 2021): what gradient-based learners can learn depends on gradient precision; exact counterexamples enable CEGIS-class learners
feedback_type.predicted_lever: fbdep(x) must intersect fb for any Dev at all; this axis defines which morphologies can develop in E at all (a hard, not soft, phase boundary)

provisional_phase_hypotheses_from_377_s1.status: PARENT_ANCHORED (Kearns 1998 / Abbe et al. 2021) — this is the registered negative control for any D5 phase diagram

rules: A phase claim varies at most two axes at once in V1 and freezes the rest.
PH-5 (parity under scalar loss only) must appear as a negative control in every D5 diagram; a diagram on which M4 'develops' under PH-5 has an assay defect.
Ecology design is charged: an ecology authored after seeing search results is ECOLOGY_DESIGN_DOMINATES (#377 §22).
Every axis value is finite; 'LARGE' data volume in a tiny world means the full finite domain, and the row says so.
relation_to_v1: Additive to ECOLOGY_CONTRACT_V1.json (Codex). V1 lists 19 candidate coordinates; V2 registers, per axis, the parent theorem that already proves a tractability/learnability flip along it (verification pending PARENT_LEDGER_V2 family P9B), so Track-B phase claims on these axes are parent-anchored. Axes without a known parent flip stay in V1 as candidates.
